legend-pragel-and-ibergeregg-loop.story: curated scenic road. limestone peaks, forest, hairpins. 35 km from Schwyz to Glarus, about 38 min of riding. The stops in between: Muotathal and Unteriberg. The highest point is about 1,750 m. Ibergeregg Pass and Pragel Pass are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
